name: TranslatableRichText

props.description: Controlled per-locale HTML, keyed by BCP-47 tag. A missing key or `""` is an empty locale.
props.name: value

props.description: The WHOLE map after an edit; only the active locale's HTML changes.
props.name: onValueChange

props.description: Tab order. Default: AppProvider `contentLocales` when set, else the registered locales.
props.name: locales

props.description: First tab. Default: the first of `contentLocales` when in `locales`, else the UI locale.
props.name: defaultLocale

props.description: Whose text an empty locale shows as its placeholder. Default: AppProvider `fallbackLocale`.
props.name: fallbackLocale

props.description: Per-locale messages: tab marks for each (glyph + screen-reader text), `aria-invalid` and FormField's error line for the active one.
props.name: errors

props.description: The tab strip's tier, as on TranslatableTextarea.
props.name: size

props.description: As on RichTextEditor; `ref` is the editor's handle.
props.name: placeholder / disabled / readOnly / labels / id

related: RichTextEditor — the single-locale editor it composes.
TranslatableTextarea — the same contract over plain text.
TranslatableField — the engine, for another control.
tagline: ONE RichTextEditor holding an HTML value per locale (`{ ja, en, vi }`), switched by locale tabs (gh#1365). The kit's TranslatableField engine — the same as TranslatableInput / TranslatableTextarea: locales and first tab from AppProvider `contentLocales`, fallback from its `fallbackLocale`, per-locale error marks, the active locale's error in FormField. An empty locale shows the fallback locale's TEXT (not its HTML) as its placeholder; switching tabs swaps the HTML without calling onValueChange.
usage: DO set `<AppProvider contentLocales={["ja", "en", "vi"]}>` once; the field then needs no `locales` and opens on the source language.
DO wrap it in FormField and pass your validator's per-locale messages as `errors` (Laravel `description.vi` → `errors.vi`).
DON'T build Tabs + RichTextEditor yourself: the tab↔panel ARIA, lang, error marks and FormField report are the TranslatableField engine's.
useCases: Product / material / recipe description stored as per-locale HTML (Astrotomic / Spatie translatable)
